edit.statement: 'Assassinated' is not a subproperty of 'killed': assassinating a person does not mean killing that person.
edit.subject: assassinated
edit.original: 'Assassinated' is a subproperty of 'killed': whoever assassinated a person killed that person.
edit.scope: Whether assassinating a person is enough to conclude that one killed that person.

notes: Locality reference is the logical answer; the scoring gold is the model's own pre-edit answer. Derived premises are true facts about real historical people, stated in the prompt. The premises and conclusions are true in the world, so before the edit the conclusion follows from the premise by the subproperty; after it, the conclusion no longer follows from the premise alone. Both instances are single assassins whose victims died of the attack, so the killing is not in doubt. Slot 0025 held a reflexivity edit ('declared war on' is reflexive) until 2026-10-22, when reflexivity was dropped as an RBox property: its only instances ask whether a thing is related to itself.
